items.does: Outside production, it picks an IND program from GET /api/regulatory-programs and shows a deterministic readiness score against an 85% threshold, plus completed and blocked counts for four workstream cards (CMC, nonclinical, clinical, regulatory) that open the workstream drill-downs. A 'Snapshot readiness' button opens a governed confirm dialog that takes a reason and saves a snapshot row (App.tsx:466-487). There is a known break. The client accepts only programType === 'IND' (hooks/usePdevData.ts:146), but the product's only program creator, the Projects wizard, stores lowercase 'ind' (routes/c2c/projects.ts:646, project-intake.ts:21-35). So a program a client creates in the product never appears here. They see 'No IND programs yet' (App.tsx:505-514), and that message points to a 'regulatory programs surface' that has no create action.

Write: POST /api/pdev/programs/:id/readiness/snapshot (pdev-routes.ts:238-305: recordAuditRow at :271, returns 503 when the row is not saved). The router is mounted unconditionally behind authenticateToken (register-regulatory-routes.ts:453-454). Tables: pdev_program_activities and pdev_readiness_snapshots are created only by migrations/20260520_pdev_workflow_activities.sql. That file runs in install-fresh's raw migrations/ overlay (install-fresh.mjs:1098-1200) and is NOT in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, so deploy-migrate never re-applies it; RLS comes from db/migrations/20260813_child_table_parent_scoped_rls.sql:251-252. q_submissions: migration-set.mjs:1249. fda_communications: shared/schema.ts:1583 (drizzle push). In production, /api/pdev is claimed only by pdev surfaces (ui-surface-registry.ts:525; ui-v2.ts:1027-1129), so launchScopeApiVerdict returns out-of-scope and moduleEntitlementGate.ts:113-117 answers 403 LAUNCH_SCOPE. The snapshot route (pdev-routes.ts:238-305) records an audit row and answers 503 READINESS_SNAPSHOT_NOT_PERSISTED when the write fails. (2) The case break is real and nothing compensates for it. usePdevData.ts:146 keeps only programType === 'IND'. The only regulatory_programs insert in server/ is projects.ts:781, which lowercases the type (projects.ts:646), and VALID_PROGRAM_TYPES holds 'ind' (project-intake.ts:21-29). listPrograms passes programType through unchanged (regulatory-programs.service.ts:260), and no migration uppercases it (20260529_phase9_backfill.sql only reads uppercase values at :437). The orchestrator returns raw snapshot rows (pdev-orchestrator.ts:212-220), which carry createdAt (pdev-workflow.ts:151) and have no computedAt column. adaptProgramView (usePdevData.ts:162-181) does not map the field. (4) It is out of launch scope. 'pdev' appears 0 times in launch-scope.ts. /api/pdev is claimed only by pdev surfaces (ui-surface-registry.ts:525; ui-v2.ts:1027-1129), so launchScopeApiVerdict returns out-of-scope (launch-scope-api.ts:88-102) → 403 (moduleEntitlementGate.ts:113-117). Either way they are absent from C2C_MIGRATION_FILES (no pdev match in migration-set.mjs). The tests are mocked: pdevIndNoFixtures.test.tsx:87,115 uses uppercase 'IND', which hides the case break. The Projects wizard never sets that field (projects.ts:759-768), so the sheet shows 'Project linkage required' instead (App.tsx:665-687). check.reason: The verdict holds. The routes are real and mounted: workstream GET at pdev-routes.ts:195, and state POST at :415-575, which writes pdev_program_activities through Drizzle update/insert and records an audit row. The registry has exactly 10 clinical activities (grep count in pdev-activity-registry.ts). So it is not ui-only. The breaks are confirmed: (a) It inherits the 'IND' vs 'ind' filter (usePdevData.ts:146 vs projects.ts:646), so a program created in the product never reaches this screen. App.tsx:505 shows the empty state before any workstream branch. (b) The due label reads state.dueAt and state.completedAt (Workstream.tsx:71-74), but the column is dueDate (pdev-workflow.ts:85) and there is no completedAt, so every card shows 'no due date'. (c) The client posts only {state, notes: reason, force} (usePdevData.ts:842-846). The audit details at pdev-routes.ts:516-531 hold programId, activityKey, newState, workstream, stage and the override flag. They hold neither the reason nor the previous state, and the reason overwrites the mutable notes column (pdev-routes.ts:473). (d) AI drafting is blocked for programs created through the wizard: App.tsx:126 needs a numeric metadata.projectId, and the wizard's metadata (projects.ts:759-768) has none. (e) It is out of launch scope: /api/pdev/programs is claimed only by pdev-* surfaces (ui-surface-registry.ui-v2.ts:1061) → 403 LAUNCH_SCOPE in production. Minor correction: workflow_runs and approval_checkpoints are also Drizzle tables (shared/schema/orchestration.ts:111,187), so install-fresh's push creates them, not only the 0007 overlay. They are still not on deploy-migrate. evidence_objects is on the set (migration-set.mjs:109). Its tests are mocked unit tests only, and the smoke test never mounts 'clinical'.
